Implementation plan

1. Files likely to change
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh`
- `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml`
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
- `tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py`
- `tests/test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback.py` (new contract test)
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

2. Functions/modules to implement
- Add `set_issue_phase_label_resilient(issue_number, target_label, repo)` to `scripts/label_helpers.sh`.
- In the new helper:
  - Call `ensure_label_exists` for `target_label`.
  - Remove mutually exclusive phase labels via resilient per-label delete (fail-open on missing label definitions/404s).
  - Ensure target label is applied via resilient add fallback.
  - Keep existing naming and fail-open style (warnings, no hard stop on recoverable label errors).
- Refactor `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` update loop to call `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` instead of inline `_AI_PHASE_LABELS` PUT/POST swap logic.
- Refactor `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` in all three required paths to call `set_issue_phase_label_resilient`:
  - `Mark linked issues ready to merge`
  - `Mark linked issues review-blocked (autofix exhaustion)`
  - `Mark linked issues review-blocked (workflow failure)`

3. Data structures affected
- Shared phase-label exclusivity list moved into `scripts/label_helpers.sh` (single source of truth for transition semantics).
- Workflow env/context additions:
  - `issue_pr_status.yml`: wire `PR_TITLE` and `PR_BODY` from event payload for fallback parsing.
  - `review_autofix.yml`: reuse existing cached metadata (`LINKED_ISSUES_JSON`, `PR_PAYLOAD_FILE`) before any PR refetch fallback.
- No MongoDB collections/contracts impacted.

4. API/interface changes
- No external user-facing interface changes.
- Internal GitHub API usage changes:
  - `issue_pr_status.yml`: fallback extraction order becomes payload-first (`PR_TITLE`/`PR_BODY`), `GET /pulls/{n}` only when payload fields are empty/unavailable.
  - `review_autofix.yml`: avoid avoidable `GET /pulls/{n}` calls by preferring already available metadata/caches in each path.
- Label transition behavior becomes centralized in helper rather than duplicated inline logic.

5. Potential risks or edge cases
- If helper sourcing fails in failure-path contexts, workflow must still fail-open without reintroducing inline `_AI_PHASE_LABELS` duplication.
- Label delete calls require correct URL encoding of label names; malformed encoding would silently skip intended removals.
- Partial GitHub API failures can leave stale phase labels; helper should keep target label add as best-effort fallback.
- Payload-first fallback must preserve current extraction regex behavior to avoid regression in issue-number detection.
- Must preserve all existing identifiers/log contracts and avoid breaking telemetry/analysis grep prefixes.

6. Testing considerations
- Extend contract tests to enforce helper reuse and prevent regressions:
  - Assert no inline `_AI_PHASE_LABELS` transition blocks remain in the two workflows.
  - Assert required `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` call sites exist.
- Add payload-fallback contract test for `issue_pr_status.yml`:
  - Assert `PR_TITLE`/`PR_BODY` env wiring exists.
  - Assert fallback parses payload first and only refetches PR when payload data is absent.
- Wire tests into CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) by adding execution of the new/updated test file(s).
- Run targeted checks:
  - `python3 tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py`
  - `python3 tests/test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback.py`
  - Existing workflow lint/test gates in CI remain unchanged otherwise.
